description: A Hotline client library & GUI in Common Lisp
intro:
This repo contains a [Hotline](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hotline_Communications) client library and a GUI, both written in Common Lisp.

The client library was entirely vibecoded (no human has touched that code) and the GUI was about 80% vibecoded. It doesn't feel appropriate to put a license on something I hardly contributed to, so I consider this public domain / CC0. I would appreciate if you sent back any improvements, though.
